description: An app customers can sign up for from its own page, such as frappe.io/raven.

fields.description: The value in the signup link, such as raven in /signup?product=raven. It cannot change after creation.
fields.label: Product Key

fields.description: A disabled product refuses new signups. Its existing sites keep running.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Shown under the heading on the signup and login pages. Leave empty to show no subtitle.
fields.label: Subtitle

fields.description: Shown one at a time while a new site starts, one line per message. For example: Setting up channels. Leave empty to show general messages.
fields.label: Setup Messages

fields.description: The app Cargo installs on this product's image, such as raven. A trial starts the newest signup image whose app tag has this value.
fields.label: Signup App

fields.description: The Frappe branch of this product's trial image, such as develop, version-16 or version-16-hotfix. Cargo builds images only for the branches in Cargo Settings, so check with Preview Trial Images before you change it.
fields.label: Frappe Version

fields.description: Where the owner lands after signing in to a trial site, such as /raven, so the app can run its own setup. Leave empty to open Desk.
fields.label: Landing Route

fields.description: Days a trial site of this product runs from when it is first ready. 0 uses Central Settings.
fields.label: Trial Days

fields.description: Days a stopped trial site is kept before its server is terminated. 0 uses Central Settings.
fields.label: Trial Deletion Days

fields.description: Show this product's logo and title instead of Frappe Cloud's in signup codes and in emails about its sites. Needs a public logo.
fields.label: Use Product Branding in Emails

fields.description: An https:// page that shows a new customer how to start, such as the product's docs. The site_ready and trial_unopened emails link to it with a Get started button.
fields.label: Getting Started URL

fields.description: An extra paragraph for a lifecycle email about a site of this product, such as what to do first in site_ready.
fields.label: Email Notes

fields.description: A short tag the in-app cloud shows next to a plan's title on a site of this product, such as Up to 200 users. The plan title and price stay the same.
fields.label: Plan Notes

name: Product
